(1) The quasi two dimensional (2D) perovskite (2D perovskite) films with a high luminescence efficiency are used in 2D perov skite solar cells (2D PVSC) to reduce the open-circuit voltage (Voc)-loss and further improve the efficiency.

In summary, our research is concerned with
a new type of perovskite materials, which have the potential to improve perovskite photovoltaic devices by reducing the open circuit voltage loss.
the development of quasi 2D halide perovkite PVSCs with high efficiency and low open circuit voltage loss.
the development of high efficiency and stable quasi 2D perovskite PVSCs, which are based on the use of highly emissive and thermally stable perovskite material.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of a highly luminescent perovskite layer in PVSCs allows for record low Voc deficit and high efficiency quasi 2D perovskite cells with outstanding stability.
the use of highly emissive perovskite in quasi 2 D PVSCs allows to obtain a record low Voc loss, and high performance and highly stable devices.

the use of highly emissive PEA0.5BA1.5MA3PbI8Cl in quasi 2 D PVSCs allows a record low Voc loss, and a champion external electoluminescence quantum efficiency up to 2.3%, and the highest reported quasi 2D perovskite PVSCs efficiency up to 15.8% under 1 sun.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed quasi 2D perovskite based PVSCs with high luminescent and ultra low Voc deficit.
, we demonstrate that highly luminescent perovskite materials can be used to fabricate efficient PVSCs.
, we have demonstrated that quasi 2D perovskite PVSCs can have a low Voc loss of 0.35 eV, and a high efficiency of 15.8%.
The main takeaway from our work is that
quasi 2D halide perovksite PVSCs with high luminescent properties and low non radiative recombinaiton can be achieved.

the use of a highly luminescent perovskite in PVSCs is key to reduce non radiative recombina tion and thus the open circuit voltage deficit, and that quasi 2D perovskites can be a promising candidate for high efficiency PVSCs.

the quasi 2D perovskite film is a very promising material for high efficiency solar cells, and the Voc loss can be reduced by a combination of Cl passivation and post heat light treatment, leading to high efficiency PVSCs.
